snippet.title: Tindark Trailer Video (English)
snippet.description:
Swipe right... if you dare.

Tindark is a psychological horror game inspired by "The Exit 8."
 Trapped in an endless dating app, you must spot the anomalies hidden in each profile to escape the loop.

One wrong swipe, and you start over.

🔗 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414130/Tindark/
